proposals.name: Runaway luminous red nova
proposals.idea: A stellar merger in the Galactic plane undergoes runaway common-envelope ejection, so the cool expanding photosphere brightens almost exponentially at nearly constant red color. Once the envelope reaches its maximum radius the rise saturates into a long-lived red plateau rather than a supernova peak and decline.

plateau_b.meaning: plateau flux of band b in microjansky

base_b.meaning: quiescent baseline flux of band b in microjansky

t_mid.meaning: day when flux reaches half its plateau value

tau_rise.meaning: exponential e-folding rise time in days

proposals.predicts: Flux will keep rising nearly exponentially with constant g-r near 1.5 mag, exceed about 1500 microjansky in r, and then flatten into a months-long plateau instead of declining like a Type Ia supernova.

proposals.name: Long-rising interacting supernova
proposals.idea: This is a heavily reddened, CSM-interacting or magnetar-powered supernova diffusing through a massive envelope, not a Type Ia. Its luminosity rises approximately exponentially for tens of days toward a broad peak still in the future, with nearly constant red color.

t_exp.meaning: explosion or shock-emergence time in days

t_peak.meaning: midpoint of the prolonged rise and start of turnover in days

tau_r.meaning: exponential diffusion rise timescale in days

tau_d.meaning: slow post-peak decline timescale in days

amp_b.meaning: band amplitude in microjansky before the decline factor

base_b.meaning: pre-explosion baseline flux in microjansky per band

proposals.predicts: It predicts the transient keeps rising for several more weeks to a broad red peak about 1.5-3 times brighter than at t=-2, then declines slowly over months, instead of already fading as the Ia model forecast.

proposals.name: slow red accretion outburst
proposals.idea: At low galactic latitude this is a Galactic FU Orionis-type accretion outburst, not a supernova: a heating front spreading through a circumstellar disk gives a months-long, roughly exponential and persistently very red rise. The outburst then saturates into a years-long plateau rather than peaking and decaying in weeks.

amp_b.meaning: plateau flux in this band, much smaller in g than r

base_b.meaning: pre-outburst quiescent flux in this band

t_mid.meaning: midpoint day of the slow rise

tau_rise.meaning: e-folding time of heating-front rise in days

plateau_len.meaning: duration of near-constant plateau in days

tau_decay.meaning: slow post-plateau decay time in days

proposals.predicts: Flux will keep rising for weeks, then flatten to a red plateau with an almost constant g-to-r ratio for hundreds of days instead of turning over and fading like a Type Ia supernova.
